## Checklist

- [ ] CI passes.
- [ ] No passwords, keys, tokens, connection links, real names, phone numbers, emails, account IDs or client data.
- [ ] Brand-specific words use placeholders such as `[Your Platform]` or `[Your Brand]`.
- [ ] New or changed skills keep the approval rules (no send, spend or delete without an explicit yes).
- [ ] I bumped the version in `plugin.json`, `marketplace.json` and the README badge.
- [ ] I added a line to `CHANGELOG.md`.
